{{Quote|Whoops.''"<br />"''Ah, perfect. For the most important state banquet of the season they send us waiter droids with malfunctioning digits.|C-3PO talking to this droid|<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>}}
This '[[LEP servant droid/Legends|''LEP servant droid''']] was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Evil Plans" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|308}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Evil Plans" />

==Biography==
This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] worked for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] when she held a party for Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]] and helped her set the main table. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] briefly spoke with this droid when he bumped into it, calling it a droid with malfunctioning digits for dropping its tray.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I tried to think of something better than 'waiters with all thumbs' 'cause they don't have thumbs. Sticky digits, malfunctioning digits.|Anthony Daniels, suggesting a dialogue change|<ref name="Evil Plans Featurette">{{SW|url=video/evil-plans-episode-featurette|text="Evil Plans" Episode Featurette}}</ref>}}
In the original script for "[[Evil Plans]]," C-3PO complains that the waiters only possess thumbs on their hands. However, C-3PO actor [[Anthony Daniels]], as he was allowed to do due to his knowledge of C-3PO's character, disagreed with the line on the belief that droids lacked a finger that could be described as a thumb. Speaking with Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]], Daniels suggested amended forms of the line in "sticky digits" or "malfunctioning digits." Filoni quickly approved the latter suggestion, much to Daniels' delight.<ref name="Evil Plans Featurette" />
